narrative.overview:
Aspire is a private dreamboard: a wall of the person's own pictures, each with a title and one line saying why. The interface is the wall, not the pictures. Its ground is warm linen with a hint of rose, its ink is warm, and its cards are white raised by nothing but luminance. Every control is a pill or a circle. There are exactly two accents and one gradient: ember acts, dusk marks, and the sunrise gradient between them stands in for a photograph wherever there is not one yet, so the empty board already looks like the board.

Density is a phone's: one column at most 34 rem wide, 16 px gutters, 12 px between cards, and a frosted bar floating over the bottom edge. Nothing in the chrome competes with a picture. The dark theme is not an inversion but a different room, a print on a dark wall: charcoal ground, graphite cards, the two accents lifted to lit hues with dark ink on them, and two faint coloured lights behind the glass.
keyCharacteristics: Warm linen ground and warm ink in the light; warm charcoal in the dark
Two accents only: ember (`--signal`) acts, dusk (`--dusk`) marks
One gradient (`--dawn`) that is theme-independent, like a photograph
White type over a bottom scrim on every photograph, in both themes
Elevation by luminance; the dream tile is the one object that casts a shadow
Every button a pill; every identity a circle; Inter 400/600, sentence case
One colour source: a literal hex outside `tokens.css` is a bug

rules.name: The Ember Acts, Dusk Marks Rule
rules.body: Ember goes only on things that do something. Dusk goes only on things that say what state something is in. Neither is decoration, and there is no third accent.

rules.name: The One Sky Rule
rules.body: `--dawn` is the only gradient. It stands in for a photograph and is allowed at scale only where a photograph would be; it does not tint chrome, cards or backgrounds.

rules.name: The Scrim Rule
rules.body: Type on an image is `--photo-ink` over `--scrim`, bottom only, in both themes. The top of a photograph stays a photograph.

rules.name: The One Hex Rule
rules.body: Every colour lives in `tokens.css`. The single exception is the ground, written once more in `app.html`'s `theme-color` and the manifest, which cannot take a custom property.

rules.name: The Two-Weight Rule
rules.body: The face is loaded at 400–600, but the build sets only 400 and 600. 500 is available and unused; do not introduce it without a reason, and never 700.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: No `text-transform: uppercase` anywhere; the label tracking (+0.24 px) is the only thing that distinguishes a label.

rules.name: The Luminance Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces have no shadow, no border and no edge. A card is raised because it is lighter than the ground; that is the whole elevation.

rules.name: The One Print Rule
rules.body: The dream tile is the only object on the ground that casts a shadow, because it is the only object that is a photograph.

rules.name: The Glass Is Never a Card Rule
rules.body: Glass frosts what scrolls under it. A surface with nothing under it is the soft surface.

dos: Do put every colour in `tokens.css` and reach it by role; the dark theme is a `--dark-*` bank pointed at twice, once under `prefers-color-scheme: dark` and once under `[data-theme='dark']`, and a new role is added in all three places.
Do raise a card by luminance alone: surface on ground, 20 px corners, no shadow, no border.
Do make every button a pill and rank it by fill: primary inverts, accent is ember, soft sits in a card, card-coloured sits on the ground, quiet is text, danger is an outline.
Do set type on a photograph in white over the bottom scrim, in both themes, and put a tile's status in the top corner as a glass tag.
Do use ember only for what acts and dusk only for what marks; the sky only where a photograph would be.
Do keep every label sentence case, on the 4 px grid, at 44 px targets or more, and stop all motion under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Do use glass only for what floats over content or sits on the ground; inside a card, use the soft surface.
donts: Don't add a third accent hue, a data colour, or a second gradient.
Don't use uppercase, weight 500 or 700, or a second typeface.
Don't put a shadow, hairline or lit edge on a card, a row or any resting surface; the dream tile is the only object on the ground that casts one.
Don't put a label above a tile's title; the title carries its own weight and status lives in the corner.
Don't frost a card or a page ground, and don't leave a floating layer translucent where the browser cannot blur.
Don't write a literal hex outside `tokens.css`, other than the ground in `theme-color` and the manifest.
Don't scale, bounce or glow on press; press is one luminance step.
